source.title: The London Office Market Q1 2026 -- A Guide To Rents, Rent Free Periods & Market Trends (Table 1)

_method: Verified 2026-08-29 against the PDF table row 'East London - Canary Wharf': GBP 52.50 (Q1 2021) | 55.00 (Q1 2025) | 57.50 (Q1 2026) | 9.52% 5yr | 4.55% 1yr. A search snippet had mis-attributed this figure to Colliers; it is Carter Jonas. Their Q2 2026 Net Effective Rents Monitor reports Canary Wharf annual growth accelerating to 5.7% but publishes no new absolute level, so Q1 stands as the latest.

facts.note: Headline rent, new & refitted mid-rise Grade A over 5,000 sq ft, excluding incentives; upper floors run GBP 62.50-72.50. Five-year change +9.52% (from GBP 52.50 at Q1 2021). Rent-free periods in the district: 13-15 months on a 5-year term.
